lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance circular spots are organized into distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill area, with the largest and most regular centroids located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the circular spots, forming a clear grid-like matrix where each spot is centered within a vertical stripe.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to low-luminance ventral shadows.

other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and dorsal surface of the pectoral fin contain a high-density clustering of micro-blobs, which are significantly smaller and more numerous than the constellations found on the primary flank.
